# allinkl_databases (Data Source)

Reads all MySQL databases of the KAS account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "allinkl_databases" "all" {}

output "database_names" {
  value = data.allinkl_databases.all.databases[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `databases` (Attributes List) Every database of the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--databases))

<a id="nestedatt--databases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `databases`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_hosts` (List of String) Allowed hosts as KAS lists them, localhost included.
- `comment` (String) Free text describing the database.
- `login` (String) Database user; the same as the name.
- `name` (String) Database name.
- `used_space` (Number) Size of the database as KAS reports it.
